name: Fisher Transform
description: This keyword returns the Fisher Transform indicator value of any period of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the Fisher Transform indicator value of any period of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632312139.png)

The above keyword will return the previous day Fisher transform value of ACC

The Fisher Transform is a technical indicator that normalizes asset prices, thus making turning points in price clearer

Read about Fisher Transform here -  https://www.investopedia.com/terms/f/fisher-transform.asp
